problems_found.problem: **当前阻塞**：客户端带 fixture 源集时被服务端协议握手拒绝
problems_found.verbatim: `Client disconnected with reason: This server requires Mekanism protocol 10.7.19`
problems_found.code_reason: `FabricMekanismNetworking.beginHandshake`：`ServerConfigurationNetworking.canSend(handler, REQUEST_TYPE)` 为 false 时断开；模板 handshake 客户端（只用 sourceSets.main）可以连上，说明是「运行里多了一个 fixture mod」让客户端的配置阶段 payload 注册没生效
